g.text: GSE308103 | observed RNA profiles and LUAD-versus-normal paired contrasts

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: A: >=50 cells per donor / compartment; equal donor weighting within each histology. Components use all-assay normalization.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: B-C: each point is one complete patient; diamonds are means, with no cell-level P values.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: IL1RN, IL1R2 and SIGIRR are regulatory context. RNA compatibility does not measure cytokine release or causal communication.
